title: Mini Sulfur Cube Fix
description: A datapack designed to fix mini Sulfur Cubes from despawning, addressing the official bug tracker issue MC-308361.
body:
# Mini Sulfur Cube Fix
In the Chaos Cubed 26.2 update, mini sulfur cubes that split from a larger parent fail to inherit the parent's persistence status, causing them to naturally **despawn** like standard hostile monsters when the player leaves the area. This data pack loops continuously in the background to automatically detect newly split mini cubes (Size:0) and apply the PersistenceRequired:1b NBT tag.

## Lag Optimized
Utilizes entity tagging (auto_saved) to ensure each newborn cube is only processed once, keeping server performance perfectly smooth.
